name: puvin-platform
description: PUVIN.IN — MEAN stack website and CMS

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @puvin/api && npm run build -w @puvin/website && npm run build -w @puvin/admin
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @puvin/api
scripts.seed: npm run build:packages && npm run seed -w @puvin/api
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @puvin/api && npm run test -w @puvin/website && npm run test -w @puvin/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w @puvin/api
